content: For Android IME logic testing without Android framework: pure JVM unit tests in src/test/ are the fastest path when the class under test has no Android API calls. Robolectric is required only when Android system services (InputConnection, Context, etc.) are involved. Mockito/MockK can stub Android interfaces (like InputConnection) for boundary testing. The key insight from Android documentation is that classes with zero Android imports can run in plain JUnit on JVM. Robolectric adds ~20MB and complex ServiceController lifecycle — justified for full-service tests, not for pure logic.
